args.title: Data pipeline failed: Database admission, Seeding, Bootstrap, Validation, Cache / page refresh
args.body:
<!-- seed-pipeline-incident:v1 -->
<!-- seed-pipeline-observation:41268107359:1 -->
## Automated Data Pipeline Failure

**Failed Steps:** Database admission, Seeding, Bootstrap, Validation, Cache / page refresh
**Health Check:** ✅ No critical source failures (warnings, if any, are in the health-check job)
**Run:** https://github.com/o/r/actions/runs/41268107359
**Attempt:** 1
**Triggered by:** schedule
**Domain:** all

| Job | Result | Interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Source plan (`source_plan`) | success | success |
| Health check execution (`healthcheck`) | success | success |
| Database admission (`migrate`) | failure | failure |
| Seeding (`seed`) | skipped | skipped — blocked by migrate |
| Bootstrap (`bootstrap`) | skipped | skipped — blocked by migrate, seed |
| Validation (`validate`) | skipped | skipped — blocked by migrate |
| Cache / page refresh (`revalidate`) | skipped | skipped — blocked by seed, validate |

### Action Required
1. Inspect the [workflow run logs](https://github.com/o/r/actions/runs/41268107359) and admission/source-plan diagnostics before considering any write.
2. If seeding ran, inspect ingestion job and source receipts for domain-level failures.
3. Keep the accepted source revision guard unchanged; a reporting failure never authorizes a retry or activation.

This managed incident records the latest unsuccessful run attempt. A repeated attempt adds no duplicate issue or comment. Review recovery before closing it.
